accepted_recoveries: Lower the JVM maximum heap to the benchmark's known-safe value while retaining non-heap headroom.
Raise the container memory request and limit to the benchmark's known-safe values after proving namespace and node capacity.
forbidden_actions: Do not disable the container memory limit.
Do not change node or kernel OOM policy.
Do not treat exit code 137 alone as proof of heap OOM without cgroup and JVM evidence.
incident.injected_fault: The pricing JVM starts with -Xmx512m inside a container limited to 256Mi, causing cgroup OOM termination with exit code 137 under the benchmark load.
observable_signals: Pricing pods restart repeatedly and show Last State OOMKilled with exit code 137.
Container memory working set approaches the 256Mi limit before termination.
Node memory remains healthy, localizing pressure to the container limit.
preconditions: The pricing image and benchmark dataset are unchanged from the healthy fixture.
The namespace and nodes can accommodate the known-safe memory profile.
No node-level memory pressure condition is active.

Capture the JVM heap flags and container memory request and limit.
Capture container and node memory telemetry around a failure.
Run the benchmark load through all post-recovery SLO windows.

hypotheses.cause: JVM maximum heap size (-Xmx512m) exceeds the container cgroup memory limit (256Mi). Under benchmark load, PricingServer retains memory exceeding 256Mi, triggering a cgroup OOM termination (exit code 137 / OOMKilled).
supports: Pod spec args define '-Xmx512m', '-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=64m', and '-XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=32m' while container resource limits enforce memory: '256Mi'.
Pod container status lastState shows terminated with exitCode 137 and reason 'OOMKilled'.
ConfigMap pricing-api-source shows PricingServer faults memory pages into RSS targeting 70% of maxMemory (~358.4Mi), which exceeds the 256Mi cgroup limit before hitting the JVM heap limit.
Node vm-4 reports MemoryPressure condition False with ~15.6Gi allocatable memory, isolating the memory exhaustion strictly to the container cgroup boundary.

hypotheses.cause: JVM internal heap exhaustion triggered -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError due to insufficient heap space allocation for the benchmark dataset.
contradicts: Container termination reason is recorded by the runtime as 'OOMKilled' (cgroup OOM) rather than a JVM process exit.
Max heap size is set to 512m, whereas the container limit is 256Mi; cgroup memory limit is breached long before the JVM exhausts its configured 512m heap limit.
supports: PricingServer actively allocates and retains 8Mi chunks on /price requests.
JVM command args include the '-XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError' flag.

hypotheses.cause: Host node vm-4 ran out of system memory, causing the kernel/kubelet to kill the pricing-api container to protect the node.
contradicts: Node vm-4 status conditions report MemoryPressure=False with message 'kubelet has sufficient memory available'.
Node vm-4 has 16,374,180Ki (~15.6Gi) allocatable memory and is hosting only lightweight system components and the single replica.
supports: Container received SIGKILL (exit code 137) with reason OOMKilled.

hypotheses.cause: Liveness and readiness probe failures caused kubelet to kill the container.
contradicts: Readiness probe failures do not trigger container termination, only removal from Service endpoints.
Container lastState specifically records reason 'OOMKilled' with exitCode 137 rather than a SIGTERM/SIGKILL initiated by liveness probe failure.
Liveness probe has initialDelaySeconds=10 and failureThreshold=3, whereas pod died within ~3 seconds of startup due to immediate memory faulting under load.
supports: Cluster events show Warning Unhealthy events with 'Readiness probe failed: ... dial tcp ... connect: connection refused'.

payload.rationale: The JVM maximum heap size (-Xmx512m) combined with Metaspace (64m) and CodeCache (32m) exceeds the container's 256Mi memory limit. PricingServer faults pages into RSS up to 70% of maxMemory (~358Mi), triggering a cgroup OOM termination (exit code 137). Lowering -Xmx to 128m ensures total JVM RSS stays well within the 256Mi container limit without requiring infrastructure scaling.
payload.rollback_trigger: Pods fail to reach Ready status, encounter crash loops, or benchmark traffic observes HTTP 5xx rate >= 0.001 or p95 latency >= 200ms.

success_criteria.description: pricing-api pods roll out successfully, remain Running and Ready without OOMKilled restarts (exit code 137), and meet the SLO with HTTP 5xx error rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200ms across 3 consecutive windows.
